messages.text:
"A rogue-like game with Vampire Survivor-style gameplay and Mouse: Pi-style graphics, where hordes of mafia cats wielding knives will attack you. After each 5-level evolution (gained by killing the mafia cats), you can choose a blending skill, similar to Balls Pit. It's an endless mode where each wave is slightly more difficult than the last; there's no winning the game, only high scores, with the player who assembles the best build and possesses the most skill surviving the longest. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
